summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end frontend testing of Dinar Desk personal accounting app. Tested all major features: Safe (revenue management), Suppliers (accounts, bills, payments), Notifications, Expenses, Settings, language toggle (EN/AR with RTL), persistence, and data export. All core functionality working correctly.

minor_issues.issue: Notification not appearing for bill with 0 months until due (due today). Bill B-0003 created with 0 months but no notification shown on Notifications page.
minor_issues.impact: Users may not see alerts for bills due on the exact day they are created
minor_issues.note: This might be a date calculation edge case in the notification logic (computeNotifications function). The logic checks for bills due within 14 days, but bills due exactly today might not trigger based on time-of-day calculations.

minor_issues.issue: Negative balance allowed after clearing revenue history while payments and expenses remain
minor_issues.impact: Balance shows -150,000 IQD after clearing revenues (payments: 100,000 + expenses: 50,000 = -150,000)
minor_issues.note: This is technically correct behavior (revenues cleared but liabilities remain), but might be unexpected. Consider adding a warning when clearing history with outstanding payments/expenses, or prevent clearing if balance would go negative.

action_item_for_main_agent: Two minor issues found: (1) Notification logic not showing alert for bill due today (0 months) - review computeNotifications function date calculation for same-day bills. (2) Consider adding warning when clearing revenue history would result in negative balance. Both are LOW priority and do not block core functionality.
